qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Strong presence in European private debt, direct lending, and structured capital with sticky multi-year fund capital. However, private debt is heavily commoditizing under aggressive competition from global mega-managers (Ares, Blackstone, Blue Owl, Oaktree). Hybrid FMC/IC balance-sheet model depresses corporate ROIC (10-11%, sub-12% hurdle) and exposes corporate capital to credit cycle default risks.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Rejected – G3 Moat & Pricing). Alternative credit and structured capital manager operating a hybrid model with a £2.5B+ balance sheet investment portfolio. Lacks pricing power in private debt amid intense institutional direct lending competition; multi-year ROIC of 10-11% fails the 12% cycle hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: ICG manages $126B in total AUM ($87B fee-earning AUM) across private debt, structured equity, and credit strategies. Corporate ROIC averages 10% to 11% due to the capital-heavy £2.57B balance-sheet investment portfolio. Direct lending fee rates (60-100 bps) face intense downward pressure from global mega-platforms, precluding inflation-plus pricing power.
